thread:
ana (product): Quick thing — thinking about adding inline hints to the filter/savequery UX that show immediate cost/telemetry impact and routing fallbacks. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike (eng): Love it. We already compute per-request cost in the analysis pipeline, could surface a lightweight estimate in the client. Need to watch perf on dropdowns though.

sara (design): Sketch attached: https://figma.com/s/example — small chip next to saved query name with "est cost / sample rate". Click expands to routing hints.

ana? (typo) ana (product): oops meant @sara, yep that. Also want to indicate if query will trigger cross-model fallback (eg large context -> cheaper quantized variant).

lee (eng-sre): On fallbacks: we have the routing matrix but it's expensive to compute on the fly. Could precompute per-saved-query by sampling recent traffic, store as metadata. That would keep client snappy.

olivia (data): We can run a nightly job to estimate 95th pct seq len, tokens / call, and which routing buckets would be used. Add fields: "expected_tokens","preferred_route","fallback_routes","telemetry_sample_rate".

mike (eng): If we add those fields, client can show: "~120 tokens · uses: model-x (primary) · fallback: model-x-q4". Keep wording terse.

sara (design): UX nit: show amber caution if estimated latency > SLO or cost > threshold. Use :warning: tooltip with explainer and link to console cost-preview.

ana? ana (product): also need to decide save-scope semantics: when a saved query moves across routes (user clones it), should we recompute estimates or mark as stale?

lee (eng-sre): mark as stale + banner "estimates based on last-run on route A" and provide quick "recompute estimates" button (async job).

olivia (data): recompute should be cheap if we only sample a handful of recent calls. We can rate-limit recompute to avoid spikes.

mike (eng): API shape proposal (very small):
```json
{
  "saved_query_id": "sq_123",
  "est_tokens": 120,
  "est_cost_cents": 5,
  "preferred_route": "us-west-1::gpu-p4",
  "fallbacks": ["gpu-q4","cpu-int8"],
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "stale": false
}
```

ana? ana (product): That looks good. For rollout: start in beta for routes with active traffic and only show chips on hover to limit visual noise.

sara (design): Will prototype hover state + compact inline chip. Also add accessibility label.

lee (eng-sre): Need a plan for telemetry: if we surface sample_rate in UI, docs must explain sampling bias. Also tie a link to telemetry explorer for that saved query.

mike (eng): Implementation notes: backend stores metadata and recompute job. UI pulls metadata in list endpoint to avoid N+1 calls. We'll add a per-route saved-query metadata cache with TTL 6h.

ana? ana (product): OK next steps: design prototype (sara), API contract PR (mike), nightly estimator job spec (olivia), banner copy + stale UX (lee). I'll sync next week. :rocket:
